C1646.title: HarassGuard: Detecting Harassment in Social VR Using Vision-Language Models
C1646.summary: A 2026 academic paper presents HarassGuard, a system that leverages vision-language models to detect physical harassment in social VR using only visual input. It notes that while social VR platforms offer immersive experiences, they also expose users to significant online harassment risks, with existing safety measures being largely reactive.
